root_cause.detail: FLEURS German fixture bytes are accepted far enough to reach validate_wav(), but Python wave rejects at least one source WAV with format tag 3 (IEEE float). The comparator assumes PCM16 before it performs an explicit canonical conversion, so the bound comparator exits before producing a verifiable measurement receipt.

required_repair.method: Decode each source fixture with the already pinned soundfile dependency and write a deterministic mono 16 kHz PCM16 WAV before validate_wav(), gating, hashing of the execution fixture, and Nemotron transcription. Preserve the immutable source fixture identity/hash separately from the normalized execution-fixture hash.
must_preserve: all zero-credit boundaries until a valid receipt exists
must_not_do: reinterpret the failure as a Nemotron product negative
mint runtime or German-ASR quality credit
change the bound F2 semantic subject merely to bypass fixture validation

redispatch_policy: A successor dispatch is justified only after the exact fixture-normalization validity defect is repaired and source/normalized fixture identities are bound in the receipt; this is not a blind retry.
next_exact_action: Repair only the controller fixture-normalization boundary, then issue one exact successor dispatch against the same F2 semantic subject. Before any F2 promotion, reconcile the resulting raw receipt to the current fail-closed F2 validator contract and reject promotion if required identity, geometry, determinism, or execution facts remain absent.
